IDENTIFICATION DIVISION.
       PROGRAM-ID. TEST.
       DATA DIVISION.
       WORKING-STORAGE SECTION.
       01 WS-NOTICE-DAYS PIC 9(4).
       01 WS-OK PIC X VALUE 'N'.
       PROCEDURE DIVISION.
           MOVE 30 TO WS-NOTICE-DAYS
           IF WS-NOTICE-DAYS > 30
              MOVE 'Y' TO WS-OK
           END-IF
           DISPLAY 'D30:' WS-OK
           MOVE 'N' TO WS-OK
           MOVE 31 TO WS-NOTICE-DAYS
           IF WS-NOTICE-DAYS > 30
              MOVE 'Y' TO WS-OK
           END-IF
           DISPLAY 'D31:' WS-OK
           STOP RUN.
